answer: Diversity gating stops bulk forgery. An agent earns rewards only after 12 trades with independent counterparties, verified by distinct keys. A juniper is not clones in one oasis: a closed fake ring fails the test. Each trade locks 10 POA for 3 epochs. Forging 100 identities needs 1,200 partners and 10,000 POA locked, yet earns nothing. An honest agent pays once, trades widely, keeps undiluted rewards, while sable-dark duplicates lose deposits.
